'''House Aybara''' is a new noble house of the [[Two Rivers]], established in {{Ne|999}} with [[Perrin Aybara]] being declared Lord of the [[Two Rivers]]. It was formally recognized by the Andoran government in {{ne|1000}} per agreement between Lord Perrin and Queen [[Elayne Trakand]]. The House is closely tied with [[House Bashere]] of [[Saldaea]], as Perrin is married to Queen [[Faile Bashere|Zarine "Faile" ni Bashere t'Aybara]], though per agreement with Queen Elayne, Perrin and Faile's children must divide the Two Rivers and Saldaea between themselves to prevent the complicated situation of Saldaea annexing traditional Andoran territory. 
==House members==
* [[Perrin Aybara|Perrin t'Bashere Aybara]], Lord of the [[Two Rivers]]; Lord [[Steward of the Dragon]] in the Two Rivers, a [[wolfbrother]] and former ''[[ta'veren]]'', raised a blacksmith in [[Emond's Field]].
** His wife, Lady [[Faile Bashere|Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara]], called "Faile" (Falcon), Queen of [[Saldaea]], Lady of [[Bashere]], [[Tyr]], and [[Sidona]], Lady of the Two Rivers, a [[Hunter of the Horn]] and founder of [[Cha Faile]].
* [[Jaim Aybara]], a distant cousin of Perrin.
==Non-noble members of the Aybara family ==
These individuals passed away before House Aybara was formally established.
*[[Con Aybara]], father of Perrin, murdered by [[Padan Fain]] in {{ne|999}}.
**[[Joslyn Aybara]], mother of Perrin, murdered by Padan Fain in {{ne|999}}.
***[[Adora Aybara]], sister of Perrin, murdered by Padan Fain in {{ne|999}}.
***[[Deselle Aybara]], sister of Perrin, murdered by Padan Fain in {{ne|999}}.
***[[Paetram Aybara]], brother of Perrin, murdered by Padan Fain in {{ne|999}}.
*[[Eward Aybara]], paternal uncle of Perrin, murdered by Padan Fain in {{ne|999}}.
**[[Magde Aybara]], wife of Eward, murdered by Padan Fain in {{ne|999}}.
==Foreseen members==
*[[Adora Aybara (granddaughter of Perrin)|Adora Aybara]] is a future Lady of the Two Rivers and Mayor of [[Emond's Field]] in one potential future seen by [[Rand al'Thor]] during the [[Last Battle]].
